remarks: Wonderful 2-Bedroom First-Floor Condo - Great Location for Commuters!  Plenty of living space in this well-maintained 2-bedroom, 1-bath first-floor unit. Newer Kitchen, Bathroom and floors, perfect for owner-occupants or investors alike! Conveniently located near Post Road with easy access to I-95, this home offers unmatched convenience for commuters. Walking distance to the bus line, restaurants, parks, and everyday amenities.  Enjoy a spacious living room and two good sized bedrooms located on opposite ends of the hallway, providing added privacy. Coin-operated laundry facilities are located in the lower level for your convenience. Includes one assigned parking space and plenty of guest parking.  Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to own in a desirable and accessible location!
